name: homework-tutor
title_zh: 只给台阶不给答案的作业陪练
tagline_zh: SEN/NCS 学生卡壳时，它把题目拆成一步步提示，走到会为止。不替写、不剧透，像老师蹲在桌边小声点拨。
tagline_en: For SEN/NCS students stuck on homework, it breaks problems into step-by-step hints—never answers. Like a teacher.
desc_en: Specialized tutoring skill for SEN and NCS students to break down homework into step by step hints without giving answers.
why_zh: 机制上反着来：先探测卡点，再给最小可行提示。每步只推进一步，确保学生自己走完最后一步，真正学会。
why_en: Inverted design: detects the exact sticking point, then offers the smallest viable nudge. Each step advances just.
limit_zh: 只认文字题（数学/科学/语言），不认图形题或需画图作答的作业。提示粒度固定，无法按学生性格调风格。产物止于解题思路。
limit_en: Text-based problems only (math/science/language); no diagrams or drawing tasks. Hint granularity is fixed, not personality-adaptive. Stops at.
title_en: Homework tutor that gives hints, not answers
